items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: This Paul Barberine, he played with us for a while.

ctx.x: go ahead now and try not to make too many mistakes.

Because he was listening. They're teachers. This man was teaching these young fellas, and they had a big band. And he was telling them, I could see him telling them something. I don't know what he was telling them. He was telling them something. And they stood there, and those guys stayed right around me. I kind of felt embarrassed, you know. But they never heard the trombone thing. That was the trombone they ever heard. So that was one of my attempts to find out whether I was good or not. And after we come back…

items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Yeah, I think Roy Palmer talked about him once.

ctx.x: The thing I probably don't know about is mentioned. Maybe David Osweiler might mention.
Yeah, I think Roy Palmer talked about him once. Nice, nice day. He couldn't remember his last name. Said his name was Mac.
Yeah, he tried a lot with Mac and Mac.

items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: I know Roy Palmer was working there, I remember that.

ctx.x: I loved it a kid. Whose band was at Fue Clothes?
I don't know whose band was at Fue Clothes. He probably started when he was buried here. I know Roy Palmer was working there, I remember that. I remember that good who was working there.
